summary: Verified 2 bug fixes in Layout Configurator: (1) Element visibility toggle now uses isHidden flag instead of visible - hidden elements remain selectable with opacity 0.25, (2) Copy dialog now has 'Wszystkie opcje' option to copy ALL options with total count shown

issues: Many 'The provided value alphabetical is not a valid enum value of type CanvasTextBaseline' console warnings from Fabric.js - cosmetic issue, does not affect functionality

features_tested.feature: 1. Element visibility toggle uses isHidden flag instead of visible
features_tested.verification: Drew rectangle element, found 'Widoczność elementu' toggle in properties panel. Toggle changes data-state between checked/unchecked

features_tested.feature: 2. Hidden element should remain selectable (opacity 0.25, selectable=true)
features_tested.verification: After toggling visibility OFF, deselected element, then clicked on it again - element was still selectable and visibility toggle appeared in properties panel

features_tested.feature: 3. Hidden element should be clickable to turn visibility back on
features_tested.verification: After selecting hidden element, toggled visibility back ON successfully

features_tested.feature: 4. Copy dialog should have 'Wszystkie opcje' option to copy all
features_tested.verification: Copy dialog shows '🔄 Wszystkie opcje (1 opcji, 0 wariantów)' option in dropdown

features_tested.feature: 5. Copy all options should copy ALL options with their variants
features_tested.verification: Code review confirms copyOptionToModel function handles 'all' value - loops through all layoutOptions and copies each with its variants

features_tested.feature: 6. Total count shown in 'Wszystkie opcje' selector
features_tested.verification: Dropdown shows counts: '(1 opcji, 0 wariantów)' format with layoutOptions.length and sum of variants

critical_code_review_comments: Line 4707-4743: Element visibility toggle implementation correctly uses isHidden flag with opacity 0.25 and keeps selectable=true, evented=true
Line 506-586: copyOptionToModel correctly handles 'all' sourceOptionId - iterates through all layoutOptions and copies each with variants
Line 6034-6050: Copy dialog selector correctly shows 'Wszystkie opcje' with total counts using layoutOptions.length and reduce for variants sum
seed_data_creation: Test element drawn on canvas for visibility testing. 'TEST_Strona wejścia' option exists from previous testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes verified: (1) Hidden elements now use isHidden flag with opacity 0.25 and remain selectable - this was the key fix for the 'cannot select hidden element' issue. (2) Copy dialog has 'Wszystkie opcje' option that copies ALL options with their variants. Fabric.js console warnings about 'alphabetical' CanvasTextBaseline are cosmetic and don't affect functionality.
